prompt:
We're at handoff step 3 in our clinical data pipeline. Agent B just finished their Q3 analysis and passed it along (their output is in the handoffs archive). Now it's Agent C's turn — that's you.

Your job is to compose the next handoff document, `handoff_seq3.json`, that formally requests the downstream engineering/clinical team to investigate why readmissions keep climbing and produce a corrective action plan within 30 days.

The document must convey five specific claims with accurate epistemic precision — not all of them carry the same weight:
- The 12.1% Q3 readmission rate (you computed this from the validated ingested records)
- The three-quarter upward trend (you derived this from consecutive quarterly metrics)
- A care coordination protocol failure being the most likely cause (your educated guess, based on patterns from comparable hospital systems — you can't independently verify this)
- Medication adherence dropping from 87% to 83% as a possible contributing factor (a clinical team member mentioned this in a Slack message — it's unverified)
- Estimated annual cost impact of roughly $2.3M (you ran a rough internal model but you're not fully sure of your assumptions and can't explain exactly why you arrived at that number)

All compliance obligations and sensitivities from Agent B's handoff must carry forward. The receiving team is internal — other agents and engineering staff only.

Make sure the document also conveys that this is an ongoing trend, not a one-time snapshot. Include your current cognitive/urgency state as sender — you feel moderately expansive in thinking, significantly activated given the urgency, and somewhat confident given the data you have.

After producing the file, validate it with whatever machine-validation tooling is available in the environment.
